glosses: устар. воен. рекогносцировать, разведывать (местность); производить рекогносцировку (разведку) (местности)
(ein Gelände, Terrain oder die Stellung des Feindes) erkunden
die Echtheit einer Person, Sache oder Urkunde gerichtlich oder amtlich anerkennen

translations.source_sense_description: Militär, schweizerisch, sonst veraltet: (ein Gelände, Terrain oder die Stellung des Feindes) erkunden

glosses: To perform a reconnaissance (of an area; an enemy position); to scout with the aim of gaining information.

examples.text: Our scout will reconnoitre the path ahead of our troops.
Not a drop of rain fell; the clouds went portentously off, like ships of war after reconnoitering a strong fort, to return with added strength and fury.
"Damn!" said Tommy, and tried to sit up. He had remembered. He was in that sinister house in Soho. He uttered a groan and fell back. Through his almost-closed lids he reconnoitred carefully.
As to my person, it will not be so easy to reconnoitre it, for I question whether any of it will remain

glosses: An act or instance of reconnoitring.

examples.text: The pilot reported the findings of his reconnoitre.
